_comment: Which systems support which metric, and under exactly what definition. This file is the executable form of the project's central claim. Publishing a cross-city series for a metric not marked supported in every system it contains is an ERROR, checked by `make check-metrics` — not a matter of anyone remembering. Every 'supported: false' carries the reason it is false, because a gap the site shows and explains is worth more than a metric quietly missing a city.

_window.note: Cross-city comparisons default to the window in which all three systems publish. Vancouver sets it: Montreal and Toronto both start earlier. Per-city views use each system's own full range.

trips.label: Trips
trips.definition: Count of rows in fact_trips with a parseable departure timestamp and a resolvable departure station. Includes unterminated trips, which are real departures.

tor-bikeshare.note: Trip-level data begins 2016; 2014-2015 is pre-aggregated and excluded.

seasonality.label: Seasonality
seasonality.definition: Trips grouped by month of year over the common window. Same trip filter as `trips`.

mtl-bixi.note: BIXI does not operate mid-November to mid-April; the winter floor is a real closure, not missing data.

duration.label: Trip duration
duration.definition: Published duration where the source gives one, else return minus departure. Excludes unterminated trips, and durations of zero, negative, or over 24 hours — a duration cannot be computed without an ending, and the others are not journeys.

mtl-bixi.note: Excludes unterminated trips; the excluded share must be stated wherever this is shown.

active_stations.label: Active stations
active_stations.definition: Distinct stations seen in that system's most recent six months of its OWN data. Not a shared cutoff, which would penalise whichever system publishes least often.

van-mobi.identity: id parsed from the station name prefix

mtl-bixi.identity: published key 2014-2021 and normalised name 2022+, reconciled to one identity through the GBFS feed (spec 35_bridge.sql)

tor-bikeshare.identity: published id from 2018, normalised name for 2016 and 2017 Q3-Q4

station_flows.label: Station flows
station_flows.definition: Origin-destination pairs and net flow per station. Requires BOTH ends, so unterminated trips are excluded.

mtl-bixi.note: 2022+ files contain unterminated trips in quantity. They are excluded here and the excluded share must be shown on the chart, not buried in methodology.

ebike_share.label: E-bike share
ebike_share.definition: Share of trips on an electric bike. NULL is not false: a system that publishes no signal is absent, never counted as zero.

mtl-bixi.reason: BIXI publishes no bike-type field in ANY era, 2014 through 2026. Verified across the full archive by pipeline/census.py, not inferred.

tor-bikeshare.signal: Bike_Model, EFIT and EFIT G5 are the electric models
tor-bikeshare.note: Bike_Model appears from the re-published 2024 file onward; earlier eras carry no bike-type column. Verified against the published series, which begins 2024-01 — an earlier note claiming 2025 was stale.

membership_mix.label: Member vs casual
membership_mix.definition: Share of trips by membership group, from each system's own raw labels mapped explicitly.

mtl-bixi.reason: is_member exists 2014-2021 and disappears at the 2022 format break. A series that ends in 2021 cannot be compared against two that run to 2026.

tor-bikeshare.granularity: Member / Casual, with label drift across eras
tor-bikeshare.note: Member / Casual, with label drift across eras. The 2018-2023 era ({Annual Member, Casual Member}) is WITHHELD: the member label decays to zero inside it while ridership peaks. See docs/decisions.md and UNRELIABLE_LABEL_ERAS in publish.py.

forecast.label: Weather scenario (registry key: forecast)
forecast.definition: ln(daily trips) regressed on daily maximum and minimum temperature, log1p precipitation, log1p snowfall, a weekend indicator, and one level per calendar month in the window. One model per system — never pooled — over operating days from the common window's first year onward, with the same TRUSTED filter and incomplete-month exclusion every other series applies. A day with any weather field NULL is dropped and counted, never imputed. Because each month carries its own level, the weather coefficients are within-month effects and say nothing about seasonality. Headline fit statistics are in-sample; 5-fold day-within-month holdout figures ship beside them, validating within-month scenarios rather than unseen months.

mtl-bixi.note: BIXI ran no winter service before December 2023, so December-March rest on the winters from 2023-24 onward. Closed days are absent from training, never entered as zeros.

tor-bikeshare.note: Pearson is the weakest of the three proxies at 19.4 km from the trip-weighted centroid — colder and snowier than the lake-moderated core the system runs in.

rebalancing_pressure.label: Rebalancing pressure
rebalancing_pressure.definition: Two views of the same quantity, both from trip records alone. Net flow by LOCAL hour of day: a departure is -1 and a return is +1, bucketed by the hour of its own timestamp. Implied minimum daily rebalancing: summed over stations, the absolute daily net flow divided by two — the fewest bike moves that could reset that day's imbalance. Linked trips only (both ends recorded), so the hourly nets sum to zero over a system's day.
rebalancing_pressure.unit: net trips per hour; bike moves per day

van-mobi.note: Mobi publishes departure and return times ON THE HOUR — 100% of rows in every era except 2019-04 and 2025-05. The source states these are rounded to the nearest hour as a privacy measure (mobibikes.ca/en/system-data, read 2026-07-31), so each label is within ±30 minutes of the true time; the daily figure is unaffected, since it aggregates by date. Measured, not assumed: the share of Vancouver trips whose return hour differs from their departure hour is 27.5%, against 25.8% predicted by its own published durations.

rebalancing_pressure.caveat: A DERIVED LOWER BOUND, not an observed count of rebalancing. It assumes an overnight reset, ignores every move made inside the day, and excludes trips without both ends. Every surface showing it must say so beside the number. Vancouver's is narrower still: Mobi states that trips made by its operations team for rebalancing and maintenance have been removed before publication (mobibikes.ca/en/system-data, read 2026-07-31), so the bound there is derived from rider trips that no longer sit beside the real operations moves — it cannot be checked against them, and does not include them.

bike_dwell.label: Dwell at a dock
bike_dwell.definition: Time from a bike's return at a dock to that same bike's next departure from that same dock. Consecutive events are ordered by time within (system, bike id) and never across systems, whose bike-id namespaces overlap. An interval whose next departure is from a DIFFERENT station is a relocation, not dwell, and is excluded.

van-mobi.note: 2017-2020 and 2024-2026 ONLY. bike_id coverage is 56.7% in 2021, 0% in 2022 and 18.6% in 2023; those years are withheld and the gap is stated on the page. Mobi's hour-only timestamps make Vancouver's dwell resolve to whole hours, which the page states beside the figures.

mtl-bixi.reason: BIXI publishes no bike identifier in ANY era, 2014 through 2026, so consecutive trips of one bike cannot be reconstructed. Verified across the full archive, not inferred.

tor-bikeshare.note: 2019 onward, at 100.0% coverage every year. 2016-2018 publish no bike identifier at all.
